evidence: A commenter loves the included open-source 3D files and instructions and plans to build JBR-001 with their son. The creator clarifies that the legs are supports, not a walking mechanism.

evidence_sources.author: salamachinas
evidence_sources.excerpt: Thanks for sharing! Love that it's open source with the 3D files and instructions included. My son and I are going to build this together. Great project.

evidence_sources.author: gvuksic
evidence_sources.excerpt: JBR-001 is made as and announced as a desktop companion, legs are there for support and appearance, but it doesnt walk.

source_story_title: Show HN: JBR-001 – An open-source 3D printable desktop robot
